messages.topbar.cloud.ariaConflict: Current cloud: {name}; duplicate name warning; open Settings · Cloud
messages.topbar.security.title: Security level: {level}{pending}{rejected} (click to open Security)
messages.topbar.security.unavailable: Security status unavailable (older daemon or read failed)
messages.settings.title: Local settings
messages.settings.applyNote: Changes apply immediately: items that need a restart restart automatically; live items apply in place.
messages.settings.language.title: Interface language (applies immediately)
messages.lock.banner: Cloud not initialized. Create or join one to unlock Sharing, Memories, Audit, and the device card.
messages.lock.toast: Create or join a cloud first
messages.lock.canvasAria: Local star map: this device is not initialized
messages.lock.settings.title: Cloud not initialized
messages.lock.settings.desc: The main console is locked. Sharing, Memories, Audit, the device card, and data actions become available after you create or join a cloud. Setup completes in this process; no restart needed.
messages.lock.settings.foot: If you already initialized from the CLI but still see the locked console, restart the daemon so this process loads the new config.
messages.lock.settings.initializing: Setup is in progress. Try again in a moment.
messages.legend.title: Legend
messages.legend.note: Local view: only relationships with known peers, not the full network topology.
messages.status.degraded.p2pOff: P2P is off. Only local memories and subscriptions are shown; connections and sync are unavailable.
messages.banner.error: Can’t reach the local daemon: {message} (last data kept)
messages.onboard.coach.title: Create a cloud or join an existing one
messages.onboard.coach.bodyBefore: A cloud is the shared space for this device’s memories. Start from the top right:
messages.onboard.create.title: New cloud
messages.onboard.create.desc: Generates the root master key and initializes in this process. Sharing, Memories, Audit, and the device card unlock immediately; no restart needed.
messages.onboard.create.error.cloudName: Enter a cloud name (up to 24 characters).
messages.onboard.create.success: Cloud created. The console is unlocked.
messages.onboard.join.title: Join cloud
messages.onboard.join.lead: Paste the one-time token from the inviter’s Invite device panel. The master key isn’t copied; this console unlocks as soon as you join.
messages.onboard.join.tokenPlaceholder: Paste the token text (or the text from the QR code)…
messages.onboard.join.error.token: Paste a join token first (the one-time token from the invite panel).
messages.onboard.join.success: Joined the cloud. The console is unlocked.
messages.onboard.error.invalidName: Names must be 1–24 characters and can’t contain /, \, or ..
messages.onboard.error.tokenInvalid: The token format is invalid. Ask the inviter to generate a new one.
messages.onboard.error.tokenExpired: The token expired. Ask the inviter to generate a new one.
messages.onboard.error.tokenRejected: The token is invalid or already used. Ask the inviter to generate a new one.
messages.onboard.error.endpointUnreachable: Can’t reach the inviter. Confirm their daemon is running and the address is reachable, then retry.
messages.onboard.error.notInitialized: Setup didn’t finish (no initialized flag). Retry, or check the daemon version.
messages.cloud.error.tokenInvalid: The token format is invalid. Ask the inviter to generate a new one.
messages.cloud.error.tokenExpired: The token expired. Ask the inviter to generate a new one.
messages.cloud.error.tokenRejected: The token is invalid or already used. Ask the inviter to generate a new one.
messages.cloud.error.invalidName: Cloud names must be 1–24 characters and can’t contain /, \, or ..
messages.cloud.error.nameTaken: A cloud with that name already exists. Choose another name.
messages.cloud.error.cloudArchived: Archived clouds can’t be renamed. Switch to it first.
messages.cloud.error.cloudBlocked: This device was removed from the current cloud and can’t rename it.
messages.cloud.error.profileNotFound: Cloud not found. The list may have changed; refresh and retry.
messages.cloud.error.profileJoinFailed: Couldn’t create the cloud. The token may already be redeemed; ask the inviter to generate a new one.
messages.cloud.error.endpointUnreachable: Can’t reach the inviter. Confirm their daemon is running and the address is reachable, then retry.
messages.cloud.error.cloudAlreadyJoined: This device already joined that cloud. You can switch to it.
messages.cloud.error.cloudDisabled: Cloud management isn’t available with a custom home or in this restricted environment. The current cloud is unchanged.
messages.cloud.error.cloudUnavailable: Cloud management isn’t available with a custom home or in this restricted environment. The current cloud is unchanged.
messages.cloud.error.cloudUnsupported: This daemon doesn’t support cloud management. Upgrade Mebular; the current cloud is unaffected.
messages.cloud.error.cloudListFailed: Couldn’t read the cloud list. The current cloud is unchanged; retry later.
messages.cloud.error.cloudRegistryInvalid: Cloud list unreadable (registry damaged). The current cloud is unchanged; repair the registry first.
messages.cloud.error.cloudRegistryLocked: Another process is writing the cloud list. Try again later.
messages.cloud.error.cloudProfilePathInvalid: Cloud directory is out of bounds; the operation was refused. The current cloud is unchanged.
messages.cloudJoin.title: Join cloud
messages.cloudJoin.lead: Paste the one-time token from the inviter. The master key isn’t copied.
messages.cloudJoin.tokenPlaceholder: Paste the token text (or the text from the QR code)…
messages.cloudJoin.warning.switch: After joining, this console switches to the new cloud. The current cloud “{name}” is archived, not deleted.
messages.cloudJoin.warning.manual: After joining, follow the prompt to switch. The current cloud “{name}” is archived, not deleted.
messages.cloudJoin.inspect.meta: Inviter device {deviceId} · Shared domain {namespace} · Valid until {expires}
messages.cloudJoin.inspect.duplicate: This device already joined “{name}”. You can switch to it.
messages.cloudJoin.result.switching: Switching to the new cloud… The console refreshes automatically when the app finishes.
messages.cloudJoin.result.manual: You’re still on “{oldName}”. Run the command below to switch. The previous cloud is archived, not deleted.
messages.cloudSwitch.title: Switch to “{name}”
messages.cloudSwitch.progressNote: The current cloud “{name}” is archived, not deleted. The console refreshes automatically when done.
messages.cloudSwitch.submittedNote: The console refreshes automatically when the app finishes. If the old cloud still appears, retry shortly.
messages.cloudSwitch.submittedJoin: Switch submitted. The console refreshes automatically when the app finishes.
messages.cloudSwitch.fallbackNote: This page can’t switch clouds directly (not in the desktop app). The current cloud is still “{current}” and won’t change by itself.
messages.cloudSwitch.fallbackWarning: Run the command below in a terminal to switch to “{name}”. The previous cloud is archived, not deleted.
messages.cloudSwitch.manual: Copy the command and switch in a terminal. The current cloud is unchanged.
messages.cloudSwitch.confirm.title: Switch cloud
messages.cloudSwitch.confirm.body:
Switch to “{name}”?

The current cloud “{current}” is archived, not deleted; you can switch back anytime.
messages.cloudSwitch.confirm.label: Switch to “{name}”
messages.invite.title: Invite device
messages.invite.safety: One-time use · Share only in person or over a trusted LAN. Regenerating invalidates the old token; existing invites can no longer be redeemed.
messages.invite.lead: Scan to join, or copy the token.
messages.invite.token.label: One-time token
messages.invite.token.fingerprintTitle: Token fingerprint: changes when the token is regenerated
messages.invite.qrUnavailable: QR code unavailable. Copy the token instead.
messages.invite.ttl.label: Valid
messages.invite.regen.success: Token regenerated. The old token is now invalid.
messages.invite.regen.failed: Couldn’t regenerate: {message}. The previous token is still shown.
messages.invite.joinDisabled.note: Join service is off. Enable it to redeem a one-time token on a new device (the master key isn’t copied; tokens last 15 minutes by default).
messages.invite.joinDisabled.help: Writes joinService.enabled=true and restarts the daemon (service-managed restarts automatically; in the foreground, restart as prompted).
messages.invite.enablingNote: Enabling the join service and writing config… The daemon restarts, then token generation continues automatically.
messages.invite.enableFailed.title: Couldn’t write the join service config.
messages.invite.enableFailed.retryHelp: Try again. If it keeps failing, check config.json write permissions or the daemon log.
messages.invite.enableFailed.readonlyHelp: This console is read-only; memory.admin write access is required.
messages.invite.pending.note: After restart the daemon reads the new config. Click Retry to generate the token and QR code.
messages.invite.warning.loopback: Endpoint is loopback-only. Set joinService.bind to 0.0.0.0 and regenerate.
messages.invite.warning.invalid: Invalid endpoint address. Check the join service in Settings → Advanced.
messages.invite.warning.unreachable: Endpoint unreachable. Check the join service settings.
messages.wizard.aria: Connect a known device manually (transport repair)
messages.wizard.title: Connect a known device
messages.wizard.local.note: If a device already in this cloud stays offline, paste its address here to repair transport. This only fixes connectivity; trust and subscriptions don’t change.
messages.wizard.note.connected: Transport repaired. Return to the star map to see if the device is online. If not, check the port/firewall and retry.
messages.wizard.note.failed: Check that the peer runs serve, the multiaddr includes /p2p/<peerId>, and the port is reachable. Then retry.
messages.wizard.successToast: Connected. Return to the star map to check whether the device is online.
